card.name: Start of table footnote definitions
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a leading word such as a colon, period, comma or "Includes" that begins the explanation of a table footnote or abbreviation. It is most common right after a footnote symbol or abbreviation in a table.

modes.label: Footnote opener
modes.description: The word "Includes" right after a footnote symbol or letter in a table note.
modes.example: †<< Includes>> patients treated with flexible dose of asen

modes.label: Definition punctuation
modes.description: A colon, comma or period that ends a short definition in a table note or grading scale.
modes.example: * ANC<<:>> absolute neutrophil count Chronic Phase C

modes.label: Metadata colon
modes.description: A colon after a label in a document information block.
modes.example: Date of revision<<: >>school choice; school commute; ethnicity and

card.plain: It marks the spot where a table footnote or abbreviation definition begins or ends.
